verdict.rationale: Lithic's Disputes API supports filing disputes with amount/reason and supporting documents, with Lithic handling network chargeback filing and representment responses (lithic-docs-10, lithic-docs-23). However, evidence does not confirm specific network reason code taxonomies, provisional credit handling, or dispute-specific status webhooks tracked through resolution (general webhook/events API exists but isn't tied to dispute lifecycle). missing for 10: provisional credit mechanics, explicit network reason code list, dispute-status webhook events, end-to-end resolution tracking evidence.
